A.title: A Place to Pause
A.subtitle: Waterloo Sydney 2025
A.description: This project is a reflection of a social condenser ideal approach of how we can utilise a space in a high urban environment to rekindle an interactive social hub in Waterloo Sydney. We aimed to reinvite a link between natural and urban aspects through the 5 senses throughout the building.
captions: Bringing back the historical aspect of the Waterloo swamp
Keeping the heritage aspect of the original heritage glass factory facade.

B.title: Intimate Classrooms
B.subtitle: Waterloo Sydney 2025
B.description: This project is a reflection of utilising the depiction of different styles of teachings on how it can be navigated through architecture. The aim of this design is to produce small intimate classrooms in an interconnected design that provides an isolated surroundings for the students from the urban green square environment without removing the sense of freedom within the students.
